itens.titulo: Amazon Slides 3% as Alphabet’s 12% Plunge Raises Stakes for AWS Report; Meta Rises 3%, Microsoft Pulls Back
itens.descricao: Amazon Slides 3% as Alphabet’s 12% Plunge Raises Stakes for AWS Report; Meta Rises 3%, Microsoft Pulls Back Yahoo Finance
trechos: Amazon Slides 3% as Alphabet’s 12% Plunge Raises Stakes for AWS Report; Meta Rises 3%, Microsoft Pulls Back Quick Read - Amazon slides 2% ahead of earnings as Alphabet's 12% plunge raises the bar for AWS, which analysts expect to grow 38%.
- Meta rose 3% after raising its 2026 capex guidance to a range of $135 billion to $145 billion, standing apart from sliding rivals Alphabet, Microsoft, and Oracle.
- UBS forecasts AWS margins at 46% for 2027, well above the 39% street consensus, making margin guidance a critical earnings watchpoint.
Amazon stock is at $246.30 in midday trading, down 3%.
Among the other AI giants, Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) stock is at $629.16, up 3%.
Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) stock is at $522.92, down 2%.
Alphabet's Selloff Raises the Bar for Amazon Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) stock trades at $286.17, down 12%, after quarterly results that disappointed investors.
Capital spending at Alphabet came to $51.36 billion, short of the $55.09 billion analyst consensus.

itens.titulo: Amazon to report Q3 earnings after the bell with AI spend under scrutiny
itens.descricao: Amazon to report Q3 earnings after the bell with AI spend under scrutiny CNBC
trechos: AWS sales are predicted to grow 38%, according to StreetAccount, compared with a 37% gain last quarter.
CEO Andy Jassy said Amazon's cloud capacity is "largely sold out" for next year, and it's received significant commitments for 2028 as well.
"We always leave a certain amount for on demand and our inference service Bedrock or EC2, but largely sold out all the big chunks," Jassy said on an Andreessen Horowitz podcast last week.
"A good chunk of '28 is sold out." Wall Street will be listening for any commentary from Amazon executives around AI spending.
Last quarter, the company hiked its capital expenditure forecast for 2026 to $220 billion, up from $200 billion.
Analysts surveyed by StreetAccount expect Amazon's capex to creep up more than $280 billion in 2027.
In July, the company reported negative free cash flow of $7.6 billion for the trailing twelve months, compared with positive free cash flow of $18.2 billion one year earlier.
It's expected to be cash flow negative in the current quarter, with an outflow of $9.9 billion, according to FactSet estimates.

itens.titulo: Alphabet heads for a $500 billion drop in market value, the biggest in its history
itens.descricao: Alphabet heads for a $500 billion drop in market value, the biggest in its history Yahoo Finance
trechos: The stock fell about 12% Thursday after its third quarter results, steeper than any session since it went public in 2004.
That puts nearly $500 billion of stock market value on the line, the second-biggest one-day loss ever for a US-listed company.
Only Nvidia (NVDA) has lost more, about $593 billion on Jan.
27, 2025, the day China's DeepSeek rattled AI investors.
Alphabet would need to close at about $274.75, down roughly 15%, to take Nvidia's record, by Yahoo Finance calculations.
It has already blown past the $400 billion SpaceX (SPCX) lost on June 22, the previous No. 2.
Its previous worst was about $275 billion on July 23.
The previous low was a slide of nearly 10% in July 2008.

itens.titulo: De temor fiscal à espera por Vale: os fatores que fazem o Ibovespa cair 1% nesta 5ª
itens.descricao: De temor fiscal à espera por Vale: os fatores que fazem o Ibovespa cair 1% nesta 5ª InfoMoney
trechos: Publicidade A queda dos índices das bolsas norte-americanas e a cautela fiscal doméstica impedem o Ibovespa de subir, nem mesmo com a forte valorização do minério de ferro, de 2,4% em Dalian (China).
O recuo ocorre apesar do crescimento na produção de óleo da Petrobras (PETR4), embora o recuo do petróleo seja contraponto.

Às 12h40 (horário de Brasília), o Ibovespa caía 0,95%, aos 169.360 pontos ante mínima em 169.156 pontos, depois de ter avançado 0,23%, na máxima em 171.402,97 pontos, próximo da abertura (171.006,10).

Depois que o Federal Reserve (Fed, o banco central norte-americano) deixou os juros inalterados, na véspera, conforme o esperado, investidores avaliam o Produto Interno Bruto (PIB), que mostrou alta de 3,4%, acima da esperada (3,2%) no terceiro trimestre.
Já o índice de preços de gastos com consumo (PCE, na sigla em inglês) dos Estados Unidos subiu 0,5% em setembro ante agosto.
Na comparação anual, o PCE avançou 3,6% em setembro.
O índice caiu 2,68%, aos 171.006,10 pontos, ainda ecoando temores fiscais.
“Seria natural ver um pouco de correção, o mercado aproveitando alguns preços.

itens.titulo: Is Alphabet a Stock to Avoid or a Once-in-a-Decade Buy on the Dip?
itens.descricao: Is Alphabet a Stock to Avoid or a Once-in-a-Decade Buy on the Dip? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG) (NASDAQ:GOOGL) shares slipped in early trading following the company's latest earnings report, and this is after a decline of about 20% from a peak back in May.
In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
90% of the search market First, a quick look at Alphabet's role in AI.
Google Search has steadily maintained a 90% share of the market, and that has ensured Alphabet's ability to generate strong and reliable revenue growth through advertising.

Demand for capacity has been soaring, as other cloud players have also noted, and this has prompted each of these "hyperscalers" to pour investment into an infrastructure build-out to keep up and, in the future, continue serving AI needs.

itens.titulo: Petrobras tem recordes de produção de óleo, gás e diesel no 3º tri
itens.descricao: Petrobras tem recordes de produção de óleo, gás e diesel no 3º tri Poder360
trechos: Os dados constam no balanço divulgado pela estatal na 4ª feira (28.out.2026).
Leia a íntegra do relatório (PDF – 1 MB).

A produção média de petróleo, LGN (líquido de gás natural) e gás natural atingiu 3,512 milhões de boed (barris de óleo equivalente por dia) no período, alta de 11,7% na comparação anual e de 5,3% acima em relação ao trimestre anterior.
A empresa atribuiu o recorde ao que classificou como o seu maior patamar de eficiência da produção em 8 anos e ao “ramp-up” de algumas das suas principais operações no pré-sal.

A estatal também registrou recordes de produção própria e operada no pré-sal, com 4,46 milhões de boed e 2,96 milhões de boed, respectivamente, e a máxima trimestral para produção operada total, com 5,08 milhões de boed.

REFINO E MERCADO INTERNO Em um movimento para evitar importações de diesel diante da alta do petróleo, a Petrobras registrou recorde na produção do combustível, com 769 mil barris por dia, alta de 6,7% em comparação anual e de 0,7% em relação ao 2º trimestre.
A estatal destacou a alta taxa de utilização do parque de refino, que atingiu 99% no período.
“Operamos o parque de refino com elevada disponibilidade e fator de utilização, assegurando a confiabilidade das operações e a maximização da produção.
